layer.capability: Assembles complete coefficientwise naturalRemainder(x1), preserving six ordinary scale channels, five normalized a^2 pressure-linear channels, the normalized a^4 Lambda^-3 pressure-square channel, and a coefficientwise second Picard shift.
forbidden_promotions: caller-supplied or fitted branch, Lambda, epsilon, amplitude, coefficient, or pressure data
mixing branches from different x1 or SchedulePressure datum
applying the angular natural resolvent to the axial expression
differentiating the already full pressure derivatives a second time
binary64 collapse of nonzero theorem-scale pressure channels
global convergence, fixed-point, downstream profile, or paper-exact claims
layer.remaining_boundary: Global weighted AxisSpace membership and infinite natural-resolvent convergence, final fixed-point convergence, derived average/pressure fields, NaturalProfileAssembly, downstream support/moment/matching/cone checks, and paper-exact velocity data remain unresolved.
numerical_caveats: finite coefficient channels are accumulated in local 96-digit Decimal arithmetic; this is not exact real arithmetic or an interval certificate
the recurrence is coefficientwise finite and does not imply an all-index weighted-space bound
the second Picard view is a coefficientwise algebraic shift and does not certify convergence to a fixed point
